title: Supplier Coordinator · BBS operational course
subtitle: Authorized supplier personnel, actual team hours, corrections and operational reporting

chapters.title: Start with a supplier access profile, not an Owner account
chapters.context: Browser-verified isolated BBS project C-0050-P-20261005. All ROLE LAB records are synthetic training; they are not real dispatch, customer acceptance, purchase or payment.
paragraphs: The Supplier Coordinator is an operational supplier profile linked to a supplier company and dated project authorization. Its underlying account can display Worker in Profile; the supplier access profile determines the restricted supplier workspace. It does not grant J&A approval rights.

This exercise uses fictional BBS ROLE LAB Training Supplier on the SAME BBS project C-0050-P-20261005. The Owner created the supplier and accounts, authorized this coordinator for BBS October 5–31, and assigned the external technician. All work narratives and receipts are synthetic training.
steps: Use your own single-use invitation or assigned sign-in credentials. Enter email and password and choose Continue to workspace.
Open Profile and confirm your own account. A Worker base-role label does not change your supplier access profile.
Open Supplier team and select the authorized BBS Installation / project. Confirm that the intended project is available before recording personnel or team work.
Ask the Owner to verify supplier linkage, active account status, authorization dates and the correct coordinator when a project is absent.
checks: Native Owner onboarding and actual coordinator login succeeded; no role or session was fabricated.
The coordinator project selector contained only the authorized BBS installation.
recovery: If no installation is offered, stop and request dated authorization from the Owner. Do not create an unrelated supplier or project.
Never share the Owner’s login with the supplier team. An operational directory record is not a login account.

figures.caption: Actual supplier coordinator session: authorized BBS project and supplier personnel scope.

chapters.title: Use the coordinator’s restricted navigation
chapters.route: Supplier team → Time / Expenses / Reports / Operational report
chapters.context: Browser-verified isolated BBS project C-0050-P-20261005. All ROLE LAB records are synthetic training; they are not real dispatch, customer acceptance, purchase or payment.
paragraphs: Supplier team handles authorized personnel and team-hour drafts. Time, Expenses and Reports handle your own operational sources. Operational report shows permitted supplier work and approval state. Profile and Help support your own account and role guidance.
The coordinator can submit work to J&A; it cannot approve those sources or certify client acceptance. Use the authorized operational workspaces shown in your navigation.
steps: Use Personnel, Record team hours and Operational report tabs in Supplier team.
Select BBS, From, To and Language in Project and reporting period; choose Apply filters before interpreting a list or total.
On a phone use the visible primary navigation and More where offered. Scroll within long tables rather than assuming hidden columns are absent.
Use Profile for your own expertise, availability and security; use Help for the Supplier Coordinator path.
checks: Coordinator desktop, 390-phone and 768-tablet views were captured.
Requests outside the coordinator’s authorized workspace returned 403 Access restricted.
recovery: Contact an owner is the handoff from a restricted screen. Returning to Supplier team does not grant the denied action.
Recheck filters after a successful save: the resulting route may retain project/dates but change the active workspace tab.

chapters.title: Verify the saved supplier roster and dates
chapters.context: Native isolated BBS role exercise · C-0050-P-20261005 · synthetic October 2026 work only
paragraphs: Personnel lists technicians within your supplier authorization. A directory technician and a login-enabled External Technician are different records. Directory creation does not activate an account.
steps: Select the authorized BBS Installation / project and inspect each name and Starts on / Ends on.

For this saved roster, the external technician is assigned October 5–31 and the directory technician October 6–31. Confirm the actual work date lies within both supplier authorization and technician assignment.
Ask the Owner to resolve missing supplier authorization or expired coverage before entering team work.
checks: The native saved roster and dated assignments were inspected.
recovery: A missing technician can reflect scope or dates. Do not add a duplicate directory entry to bypass an expired assignment.

figures.caption: Native Personnel roster with saved technicians and assignment dates for the authorized project.

chapters.title: Add a directory technician with the exact fields
chapters.context: Native isolated BBS role exercise · C-0050-P-20261005 · synthetic October 2026 work only
paragraphs: Add technician creates an operational directory entry in the authorized installation. Account invitation, activation and login belong to the Owner.
steps: Choose Add technician. Required fields are Installation / project, Name and Starts on.
Optional fields are Email, Phone, Company, Contact name, Notes and Ends on (optional). Supply only accurate information; set end coverage when known.
Choose Add technician and verify the saved name and assignment dates in Personnel before recording hours.
checks: The native form labels and existing saved roster were inspected. A new duplicate technician was not created during this remediation.
recovery: An email in this directory form is contact information, not proof that a sign-in account exists.

figures.caption: Actual Add technician form; required assignment/name fields and optional contact/end fields.

chapters.title: Record actual duration for selected technicians
chapters.context: Native isolated BBS role exercise · C-0050-P-20261005 · synthetic October 2026 work only
paragraphs: Actual hours applies to each selected technician. Two selected people at 0.5 h each create two drafts totaling 1 team hour. Do not enter a combined team total as each person’s duration.
steps: Select BBS and Work date 2026-10-14. Choose only the two technicians who performed the synthetic documentation activity.
Enter Category, Actual hours 0.5 and precise Work performed. Check the selected names, count 2, work date and per-person duration.
Choose Save selected drafts. Verify the success result reports two saved drafts, then inspect both individual sources before submission.
checks: Native saved drafts: external technician 01a11178-7915-7759-aec3-4df5406c5e2e and directory technician 01a11178-7918-765b-9139-1e242d1409a0, 30 minutes each.
recovery: If only some technicians are eligible, correct assignment/date scope before saving. Never assume the selected count proves every intended person was saved.

figures.caption: Native form reference for the saved October 14 example: two selected names, date and 0.5 actual hours each. Reopened for inspection; no duplicate save was made.
Native Save selected drafts result and saved selected technician work.

chapters.title: Inspect each saved team draft and submit to J&A
chapters.context: Native isolated BBS role exercise · C-0050-P-20261005 · synthetic October 2026 work only
paragraphs: Team submission is operational handoff. Supplier time is reviewed by the Owner. PM review of Daily or Technical reports is a separate workflow. See Review authority · who receives each source (review-authority) and Recovery · correct a source or request help (recovery-matrix).
steps: Open the saved drafts and compare name, work date, category, duration and activity for each person.
Select the intended drafts and choose Submit selected drafts. Verify the native success result and the exact sources now Submitted.
Check later review on each source. In the October 14 example Owner approved the external technician’s 0.5 h and returned the directory technician’s 0.5 h.
checks: Native two-draft submission succeeded. Later mixed review states were inspected, rather than inferred from a submitted count.
recovery: Keep unsent drafts separate from sources already submitted. An unavailable submit action requires checking source state and coverage.

figures.caption: Native result confirms two selected drafts submitted to J&A.
Later Owner review differs by technician; inspect individual states.

chapters.title: Create a linked correction for returned team work
chapters.route: Supplier team → returned row → Create correction
chapters.context: Native isolated BBS role exercise · C-0050-P-20261005 · synthetic October 2026 work only
paragraphs: A returned row remains Needs changes. The linked replacement carries the corrected facts and reason; it does not erase the original.
steps: Open the returned technician source and read the Owner reason. In the correction form inspect Work date, Category, Duration in hours, Work performed and Reason for correction.
Enter the actual corrected duration and choose Create correction draft. Review the link to the original.
Submit the corrected draft to J&A, then reopen it after Owner review. Verify its state and exclude the returned original from approved totals.
checks: The October 14 duration correction 01a11189-198d-731d-9f8d-9e124aba990e first reached Submitted at 15 minutes. Owner then requested clearer offline activity wording without changing duration. The coordinator created and submitted linked replacement 01a11197-6484-75a6-8c75-dd7a30b82764; Owner approved the final 15-minute source. The final native report retains the original 30-minute source as Needs changes/superseded and the intermediate 15-minute source as Rejected; the latest 15-minute source is Approved.
The historical October 6 correction 01a10e50-5f09-7290-8a50-92767e39e3f0 is Approved at 90 minutes; its returned 120-minute original remains historical.
recovery: Do not change the old source or count original and replacement together. Ask the Owner if the reason does not identify the actual correction needed.

figures.caption: Actual native linked correction form: date, category, duration, work performed and reason before Create correction draft.
Final native history: original 30-minute row Needs changes/superseded, intermediate 15-minute row Rejected, current 15-minute replacement Approved.

chapters.title: Keep the before checkpoint and export the final filtered totals
chapters.context: Native isolated BBS role exercise · C-0050-P-20261005 · synthetic October 2026 work only
paragraphs: The earlier October 6 screenshot and CSV show two Submitted rows totaling 4 h. They document the before-review checkpoint. They cannot substantiate the later approved total.

The final October 6 filter shows 120 Approved minutes for the external technician and the directory technician’s 90-minute Approved correction: 210 minutes = 3.5 h. Returned 120-minute directory source 01a10e4b-c344-754a-969c-73b0bcae1a1e is not counted twice. Later October work requires its own filters.
steps: Open Operational report, choose BBS, From 2026-10-06 and To 2026-10-06.
Compare both technician rows and Approved states. Choose Download CSV and verify two rows, 210 actual minutes and 3.5 actual hours against the filtered screen.
Retain the earlier 4 h Submitted export as before history; use supplier-final-oct06.csv for the final 3.5 h Approved evidence.
checks: Final native CSV matches Approved sources 01a10e4b-c33e-7033-a065-d3980b92c94d and 01a10e50-5f09-7290-8a50-92767e39e3f0. It contains operational activity and recorder attribution.
recovery: Compare the same dates, technician scope and review states before reporting a discrepancy.

figures.caption: Historical before checkpoint: October 6, two Submitted rows, 4 h.
Final exact October 6 filter: two Approved rows, 3.5 h, matching the new native CSV.

chapters.title: Keep your own work separate and submit eligible weekly drafts
chapters.context: Native isolated BBS role exercise · C-0050-P-20261005 · synthetic October 2026 work only
paragraphs: Your own time is a worker source, separate from technician team rows. Never record the same activity as both your own and a technician’s work.
steps: Save truthful own time on the assigned BBS project. Submit an individual draft when ready.
For the week of October 12, inspect eligible ordinary draft 01a11181-d654-7628-afb8-8a4ea00b4539 and correction draft 01a11181-c862-75f1-a8a7-96688534e4c6, both version 1 and 15 minutes.
Choose Submit this week and verify both exact sources became Submitted. The returned October 17 original 01a11180-fb49-755b-b108-b0d6d641978c remains Needs changes.
checks: Native weekly submission included both ordinary and eligible linked correction drafts, count 2, and succeeded for both sources. These Submitted states do not prove approval or payment.
recovery: Copy previous week layout is a source-checked draft convenience, not proof of worked hours. Check dates and actual work before using it.

figures.caption: Current own selected-week workspace following the historical two-source submission. Inspect each source’s present state; the before-submission drafts are historical.

chapters.title: Save your own expense receipt and submit the facts
chapters.context: Native isolated BBS role exercise · C-0050-P-20261005 · synthetic October 2026 work only
paragraphs: An own expense belongs to the person who actually incurred it. Submission records operational facts; it does not prove reimbursement.
steps: Choose BBS, Category, Date, Amount, Currency, Who paid, Description and Payment method. Vendor, occurrence time and related logged hours are optional where shown.
Choose a private receipt image or PDF. Save draft, then inspect amount/currency/payer, receipt filename and the saved receipt before Submit.
Choose Submit and reopen the own source. Verify Submitted and the registered private receipt link.
checks: Native October 16 source 01a11180-9dbf-7543-bdc9-f851e7de886a records USD 6.50, Project materials, Worker paid, a clearly fictional vendor and training cash. A unique synthetic receipt PDF was saved; Submit succeeded. No purchase or payment occurred.
recovery: If a receipt hash is already registered, inspect the existing private content. Do not repeatedly upload a duplicate or invent a new purchase to bypass the duplicate guard.

figures.caption: Native receipt-backed expense form with actual payer, amount, receipt control and the full Save draft action. Recaptured filled illustration; no duplicate was saved.
Actual Submitted own expense with its saved private receipt.

chapters.title: Create, submit and download your own Daily report
chapters.context: Native isolated BBS role exercise · C-0050-P-20261005 · synthetic October 2026 work only
paragraphs: This is your own authored operational report, separate from supplier technician time. It contains synthetic training facts and no live equipment change. PM review of the report does not approve supplier time.
The saved preview and generated PDF reflect source facts. Queued is pending; Ready enables the native download.
steps: Create your own Daily report with BBS and Report date 2026-10-13. Enter actual facts and Save draft.
Complete site/shift, summary, tasks completed, open items and next-day plan. A next-day plan is a proposal, not a published dispatch.
Submit the saved source for authorized operational review. Reopen it after PM review and verify Approved and source v3.

recovery: Correct the authorized source and generate the new saved version when facts change; preserve prior source/PDF history.

chapters.title: Maintain your own availability and secure access
chapters.route: Profile → Expertise and availability / Account security → Help
chapters.context: Browser-verified isolated BBS project C-0050-P-20261005. All ROLE LAB records are synthetic training; they are not real dispatch, customer acceptance, purchase or payment.
paragraphs: Coordinator Profile holds your own expertise and availability. Availability uses UTC. Security settings concern your own signed-in account, not an inspected supplier technician.
Help provides the English Supplier Coordinator BBS course. Use its role-specific procedures and the shared access, security and recovery sections included in this course.
For invitation and sign-in use Access · activate the invitation and sign in (access). For MFA, devices and recovery use Security · verify your own device and recovery options (security).
steps: Open Profile and verify your own name/email. Inspect expertise and availability before recording or arranging work.
For an actual availability change choose Add availability, enter UTC Starts/Ends, select the status and Note, save and reopen. This mutation was not executed for the coordinator packet.
Use Register passkey or Enable MFA only on your own device with secure recovery storage. These controls were inspected; no credential/device mutation was performed.
Open Help, choose the desired language and Supplier Coordinator starting path. English role guides may be linked as a language fallback.
Sign out after use. Use the organization’s approved contact path for an access problem rather than sharing another role’s credentials.
checks: Actual coordinator Profile and Help loaded, including own workforce scope and role-specific starting guidance.
No passwords, cookies, tokens or MFA recovery material were included in screenshots or manuals.
recovery: An account labelled Worker in Profile may still carry a supplier restriction; ask the Owner to verify its profile/linkage and the authorized project.
Report UI problems with role, BBS reference, date, source state and exact action/error; omit private credentials.

figures.caption: Actual coordinator phone Profile: own expertise and availability.
Current coordinator Help: the Supplier Coordinator BBS course is available for this role.

chapters.title: Finish the supplier operational cycle
chapters.route: Personnel → Drafts → J&A review → Operational report
chapters.context: Browser-verified isolated BBS project C-0050-P-20261005. All ROLE LAB records are synthetic training; they are not real dispatch, customer acceptance, purchase or payment.
paragraphs: The coordinator’s cycle is authorized personnel, accurate actual team drafts, explicit submission, returned correction when needed and an operational status export. Source review and customer acceptance are separate handoffs.

Native coverage includes saved roster inspection, selected team draft save/submission, Owner review and linked correction, exact final 3.5 h Approved CSV, own ordinary/correction weekly submission, own receipt expense submission, own Daily/Technical approval by PM, private Technical evidence upload, Ready PDF generation and downloads. Historical screenshots retain their checkpoint dates. See Completion check · your permitted role cycle (verification).
steps: Confirm BBS authorization and each technician’s work-date coverage before entering actual hours.
Review saved sources and submit the intended batch only once. Send the reviewer a clear project/date/source handoff.
Follow Needs changes through a linked correction and re-review; compare active totals with the retained original history.
Export the operational report with the correct period/state and describe its meaning. Hand customer-acceptance and other out-of-scope questions to the designated J&A contact.
Keep your own Time, Expenses and Reports distinct from technician team sources and report unresolved access/preview problems.
checks: No production data, real equipment, live dispatch, customer consent, outward mail or bank payment was changed or asserted by this training packet.
Earlier BBS operational records were preserved.
recovery: Do not duplicate work to fix a locked source. Explain the source ID, period and exact message to the designated contact.
If access ends or assignment dates expire, ask Owner to review the genuine authorization. A directory record alone cannot restore login.

chapters.title: Planning appendix · turn work instructions into actual team facts
chapters.route: Supplier team → Record team hours → Operational report
chapters.context: Isolated BBS planning lab · real role browser sessions · fictional October 22–23, 2026 work · no production changes
paragraphs: Supplier project authorization and personnel assignment establish who may work and on which dates. Internal published planning is separate. Supplier Coordinator navigation opens Supplier team and does not expose Today or Planning; the direct Planning route returns Access restricted. Arrange operational instructions through the Owner’s approved coordination process.

The native October 23 exercise selected two existing fictional supplier technicians, used Same hours for everyone and entered one actual hour. Save selected drafts created two individual sources totaling two team hours, attributed to their respective technicians and Recorded by the coordinator. Shared entry is not one combined person record.

The actual work form records completed work; it has no goal-acceptance action. A technician can inspect their own coordinator-recorded hour; other technicians’ sources remain outside their authorized scope.
steps: Open Supplier team. Choose BBS under Installation / project and Record team hours. Confirm each technician’s displayed assignment dates cover 2026-10-23.

Choose Add visible to selection or select the intended technicians individually. Verify two selected. Set Work date 2026-10-23, Same hours for everyone, Actual hours 1 and the fictional Work performed summary.
Choose Save selected drafts. Confirm Batch saved: 2 drafts and 2 team hours. Saving alone does not submit them.
Set From and To to 2026-10-23 and choose Apply filters. Inspect both separate drafts, then Select up to 100 drafts. Verify the selection is exactly the intended two before Submit selected to J&A.

Open Operational report with the same project/date filter. Verify total two hours, individual one-hour rows and Recorded by attribution. Authorized J&A Owner review subsequently changes both sources to Approved.
checks: Native two-person batch save, explicit submission and Owner operational approval succeeded. Both source IDs retained 60 minutes and the correct person attribution.
Coordinator report totals 2; External Technician report totals only their own 1. Native desktop, tablet and phone report views loaded without application errors.
recovery: If drafts are absent immediately after saving, inspect the selected report period: a successful October 23 save is outside an October 1–6 filter. Update From/To before considering another save.
Supplier hours are excluded from the ordinary PM Time approval queue. Hand their project/date/source IDs to an authorized J&A Owner; PM report review is a different workflow.
Preserve the source and request a linked correction for reviewed facts. Do not enter another hour to attract review.

figures.caption: Native two-technician selection: one hour each, not two hours for each person.
Two distinct one-hour sources Submitted, both Recorded by the Supplier Coordinator.
After authorized Owner review: two Approved one-hour sources and total actual hours 2.

chapters.title: Coverage appendix · missing people, dates and work goals
chapters.route: Supplier team → Record team hours; own Reports → Daily
chapters.context: Isolated BBS planning lab · real role browser sessions · fictional October 22–23, 2026 work · no production changes
paragraphs: The worked supplier authorization and technician assignments end October 31. Moving Work date to November 1 removed both eligible technicians, cleared the selection and disabled Save selected drafts. The app’s No matching records hint mentions search/status generically; in this exercise the actual reason was date coverage. No November 1 source was saved.

An assigned project and a published plan are not interchangeable. This coordinator profile cannot inspect an internal agenda, publish plans or accept goals. A current supplier grant still does not enable the internal Planning calendar.

Use your own Daily report’s Tasks completed, Open items and Next-day plan for truthful coordination notes. Those fields record narrative progress rather than a task status, a published shift, actual hours or customer acceptance. The External Technician chapter demonstrates the same native narrative fields through save, submission and PM operational approval.
steps: When personnel disappear, first verify Work date and the displayed assignment interval. Clear an accidental search and confirm BBS before requesting scope changes.

For November 1 in this exercise, stop: coverage ended October 31. Ask the Owner to confirm a genuinely authorized extension and supplier/project relationship. Do not shift the date to make a prohibited work entry save.
When a plan is missing, obtain the instructions from the authorized Owner/coordinator channel; return to Supplier team instead of repeatedly opening the denied Planning route.

For your own coordination narrative open Reports → New daily report. Describe your own completed tasks, unresolved items and proposed next-day steps, then follow Save daily report → Submit for review and the permitted review handoff.
For technician time inspect individual attribution and active totals. A goal description or future plan does not supply actual work evidence.
checks: Changing the native team form to an uncovered date removed eligible personnel and disabled saving. Read-only database verification confirmed zero exercise sources on November 1.
Native restricted Planning showed Access restricted and a Supplier recovery link. The coordinator returned to the authorized operational workspace.
recovery: Include role, supplier, project, intended work date and exact missing/disabled control in an access request. Never include passwords or session material.
A directory technician may have no login. Ask the Owner to distinguish personnel creation, individual account activation, supplier authorization and dated project assignment.

For expected-hour discrepancies in your own Time screen, use the effective schedule target and Actual minus Expected; do not interpret a plan duration as the schedule target. Ask the Owner to investigate an unavailable — expectation.

figures.caption: November 1 lies outside October 31 coverage: no eligible technicians, zero selected and disabled Save selected drafts. No time was created.
Native Supplier Coordinator Planning restriction and Supplier recovery route. This is the profile boundary, not missing project coverage.
Phone operational report preserves person, actual duration, state and attribution. This capture is the Submitted checkpoint before Owner review.
